examples.input:
You want to test your model's ability to predict properties of materials with compositions outside your training range. What characterizes a good train/validation/test split?

Options:
1. Representative distribution in each set
2. Larger test set than training set
3. Test set covers different composition space than training
4. No overlap between sets
